pt.L: E o rei Salomão fez duzentos escudos grandes de ouro batido; seiscentos [siclos de] ouro batido ele pôs em cada escudo grande.
pt.B: O rei Salomão fez duzentos escudos grandes de ouro batido, e em cada escudo foram usados {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de ouro batido.
pt.R: O rei Salomão fez duzentos escudos grandes de ouro martelado. Em cada um foram usados {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de ouro.

decisions.choice: large shields: tall shields that covered the whole body
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:16, this word names the large shield that protected a soldier from head to foot, unlike the smaller shield of verse 16.

decisions.choice: of beaten gold: gold hammered thin, likely over a frame
decisions.reason: The gold was beaten thin and laid on the shield, probably over wood or leather. These were ceremonial shields, a display of wealth; Shishak of Egypt later carried them off (12:9-10).

decisions.choice: six hundred of gold: 600 shekels
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives only the number; the unit understood is the shekel. Chronicles repeats "beaten" with the second mention of the gold, which 1 Kings 10:16 does not; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: [shekels of] (Literal); about 15 pounds (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies "shekels" in brackets; Balanced and Readable give the weight in modern measure, with "600 shekels" as the alternative. Readable leaves out the repeated "hammered".

source.text: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֤וֹת מָֽגִנִּים֙ זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֔וּט שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ זָהָ֔ב יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־הַמָּגֵ֣ן הָאֶחָ֑ת וַיִּתְּנֵ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּבֵ֖ית יַ֥עַר הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And three hundred shields gold beaten; three hundred gold he put up on the shield the one; and put them the king [in the] house of [the] forest of the Lebanon.

en.L: And 300 shields of beaten gold; 300 [shekels of] gold he put on each shield. And the king put them [in the] house of the forest of Lebanon.
en.B: He also made 300 shields of beaten gold, with {{units:about 7 1/2 pounds|300 shekels}} of gold going into each shield. The king placed them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
en.R: He also made 300 smaller shields of hammered gold. Each one used {{units:about 7 1/2 pounds|300 shekels}} of gold. The king put them in the great hall called the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

es.L: Y trescientos escudos de oro batido; trescientos [siclos de] oro puso en cada escudo. Y el rey los puso en la Casa del Bosque del Líbano.
es.B: Hizo también trescientos escudos de oro batido, y en cada escudo se usaron {{units:unos 3,5 kilos|trescientos siclos}} de oro. El rey los puso en la Casa del Bosque del Líbano.
es.R: Hizo también trescientos escudos más pequeños de oro martillado. En cada uno usó {{units:unos 3,5 kilos|trescientos siclos}} de oro. El rey los puso en la gran sala llamada Casa del Bosque del Líbano.

fr.L: Et trois cents boucliers d’or battu ; il mettait trois cents [sicles] d’or sur chaque bouclier. Et le roi les mit [dans la] Maison de la Forêt du Liban.
fr.B: Il fit aussi trois cents boucliers d’or battu, et pour chacun il employa {{units:environ 3,5 kilos|300 sicles}} d’or. Le roi les plaça dans la Maison de la Forêt du Liban.
fr.R: Il a aussi fait trois cents boucliers plus petits en or battu. Pour chacun, il a utilisé {{units:environ 3,5 kilos|300 sicles}} d’or. Le roi les a placés dans la grande salle qu’on appelait la Maison de la Forêt du Liban.

sw.L: Na ngao 300 za dhahabu iliyofuliwa; [shekeli] 300 za dhahabu akaziweka katika kila ngao. Mfalme akaziweka [katika] Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni.
sw.B: Alifanya pia ngao 300 za dhahabu iliyofuliwa, na {{units:karibu kilo 3.45|shekeli 300}} za dhahabu ziliingia katika kila ngao. Mfalme akaziweka katika Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni.
sw.R: Alifanya pia ngao ndogo 300 za dhahabu iliyofuliwa. Kila moja ilitumia {{units:karibu kilo 3.45|shekeli 300}} za dhahabu. Mfalme akaziweka katika ukumbi mkubwa ulioitwa Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni.

vi.L: [Vua cũng làm] 300 cái khiên bằng vàng dát; vua dùng 300 [siếc-lơ] vàng cho mỗi khiên. Vua để chúng [trong] Cung Rừng Li-ban.
vi.B: Vua cũng làm 300 cái khiên nhỏ bằng vàng dát, mỗi khiên dùng {{units:khoảng 3,5 kg|300 siếc-lơ}} vàng. Vua đặt các khiên ấy trong Cung Rừng Li-ban.
vi.R: Vua cũng làm 300 cái khiên nhỏ hơn bằng vàng đập mỏng. Mỗi khiên dùng {{units:khoảng 3,5 kg|300 siếc-lơ}} vàng. Vua đặt các khiên ấy trong tòa nhà lớn gọi là Cung Rừng Li-ban.

ko.L: 그리고 두들겨 편 금으로 [작은] 방패 300개를 [만들었는데], 방패 하나에 금 300 [세겔을] 입혔다. 그리고 왕은 그것들을 레바논 숲의 집에 두었다.
ko.B: 그는 또 두들겨 편 금으로 작은 방패 300개를 만들었는데, 방패 하나에 금 {{units:3.5킬로그램쯤|300세겔}}이 들어갔다. 왕은 그것들을 '레바논 숲 궁'에 두었다.
ko.R: 그는 또 금을 두들겨 펴서 작은 방패 300개를 만들었다. 방패 하나에 금이 {{units:3.5킬로그램쯤|300세겔}}씩 들어갔다. 왕은 그것들을 '레바논 숲 궁'이라는 큰 건물에 두었다.

pt.L: E trezentos escudos de ouro batido; trezentos [siclos de] ouro ele pôs em cada escudo. E o rei os pôs [na] casa da floresta do Líbano.
pt.B: Fez também trezentos escudos de ouro batido, e em cada escudo foram usados {{units:cerca de 3,5 quilos|trezentos siclos}} de ouro. O rei os colocou na Casa da Floresta do Líbano.
pt.R: Ele também fez trezentos escudos menores de ouro martelado. Em cada um foram usados {{units:cerca de 3,5 quilos|trezentos siclos}} de ouro. O rei os colocou no grande salão chamado Casa da Floresta do Líbano.

decisions.choice: shields: smaller round shields
decisions.reason: This is the common shield carried on the arm, smaller than the large shield of verse 15.

decisions.choice: 300 shekels of gold for each shield, where 1 Kings 10:17 has three minas
decisions.reason: Kings says three minas of gold went into each shield. A mina is usually reckoned at fifty shekels, which would make 150 shekels; Chronicles has 300. The two may count by different standards for the mina, or a number may have changed in copying. This translation follows the number Chronicles gives.

decisions.choice: the House of the Forest of Lebanon: Solomon's great hall
decisions.reason: This was the largest of Solomon's palace buildings, named for its rows of cedar pillars from Lebanon (1 Kings 7:2-5). It seems to have served as a hall of state and an armory (Isaiah 22:8).

decisions.choice: He also made
decisions.reason: The Hebrew continues the list from verse 15 without a verb; Balanced and Readable repeat "made". Readable says "smaller shields" to mark the difference from the large ones.

decisions.choice: about 7 1/2 pounds (300 shekels as the alternative)
decisions.reason: At about 0.4 ounce to the shekel, 300 shekels is about 7 1/2 pounds. Literal supplies "shekels" in brackets. Readable adds "the great hall called" so that the House of the Forest of Lebanon is not taken for a forest.

decisions.choice: "trescientos siclos"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has three hundred shekels where 1 Kings 10:17 has three minas (meaning decision); the shekel is counted at 11,5 g.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 3,5 kg", with "300 siếc-lơ" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Shekel 11,5 g; Chronicles has 300 shekels where 1 Kings 10:17 has three minas (m2).

decisions.choice: "3.5킬로그램쯤" for 300 shekels
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives 300 shekels where Kings has three minas; the shekel at 11.5 g.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 3,5 quilos|trezentos siclos}}
decisions.reason: Chronicles has 300 shekels where Kings has three minas (m2); at 11,5 g to the shekel that is about 3.450 g, so "cerca de 3,5 quilos", with the shekels as the alternative. "A Casa da Floresta do Líbano" keeps the capitals of 1 Kings 10:17 at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁ֖ן גָּד֑וֹל וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And made the king throne of ivory great, and he overlaid it gold pure.

en.L: And the king made a great throne of ivory, and he overlaid it [with] pure gold.
en.B: Then the king made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with pure gold.
en.R: The king also made a large throne decorated with ivory and covered it with pure gold.

es.L: E hizo el rey un gran trono de marfil, y lo revistió de oro puro.
es.B: Luego el rey hizo un gran trono de marfil y lo revistió de oro puro.
es.R: El rey hizo también un gran trono adornado con marfil y lo cubrió con oro puro.

fr.L: Et le roi fit un grand trône d’ivoire, et il le recouvrit d’or pur.
fr.B: Puis le roi fit un grand trône d’ivoire et le recouvrit d’or pur.
fr.R: Le roi a aussi fait un grand trône décoré d’ivoire et il l’a couvert d’or pur.

sw.L: Mfalme akafanya kiti kikubwa cha enzi cha pembe za ndovu, akakifunika [kwa] dhahabu safi.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme akafanya kiti kikubwa cha enzi cha pembe za ndovu, akakifunika kwa dhahabu safi.
sw.R: Mfalme alifanya pia kiti kikubwa cha enzi kilichopambwa kwa pembe za ndovu, akakifunika kwa dhahabu safi.

vi.L: Vua làm một cái ngai lớn bằng ngà và bọc nó [bằng] vàng ròng.
vi.B: Vua cũng làm một cái ngai lớn bằng ngà và bọc vàng ròng.
vi.R: Vua cũng làm một cái ngai lớn khảm ngà và bọc vàng ròng.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 상아로 큰 왕좌를 만들고 순금으로 그것을 입혔다.
ko.B: 왕은 또 상아로 큰 왕좌를 만들고 순금으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 왕은 또 상아로 장식한 큰 왕좌를 만들고, 순금으로 덮었다.

pt.L: E o rei fez um grande trono de marfim, e o cobriu [de] ouro puro.
pt.B: Depois o rei fez um grande trono de marfim e o revestiu de ouro puro.
pt.R: O rei também fez um trono grande decorado com marfim e o cobriu com ouro puro.

decisions.choice: a throne of ivory: a throne inlaid with ivory panels
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:18, ivory was carved into panels and set into wooden furniture; a throne could not be overlaid with gold if it were solid ivory (Amos 3:15).

decisions.choice: pure gold: where 1 Kings 10:18 has "refined gold"
decisions.reason: Kings uses a rarer word for the finest grade of gold; Chronicles uses the common word "pure". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: decorated with ivory; covered
decisions.reason: Readable says how the ivory was used and says "covered" for "overlaid".

decisions.choice: ouro puro
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the common word "pure" where Kings has "refined" (m2), so the Portuguese of 1 Kings 10:18 says "ouro puro" here.

source.text: וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מַעֲל֣וֹת לַ֠כִּסֵּא וְכֶ֨בֶשׁ בַּזָּהָ֤ב לַכִּסֵּא֙ מָאֳחָזִ֔ים וְיָד֛וֹת מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה עַל־מְק֣וֹם הַשָּׁ֑בֶת וּשְׁנַ֣יִם אֲרָי֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים אֵ֥צֶל הַיָּדֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And six steps to the throne, and [a] footstool in gold to the throne [were] fastened, and hands from this and from this at [the] place of the sitting, and two lions standing beside the hands.

en.L: And six steps [were] to the throne, and a footstool of gold [was] to the throne, fastened [to it], and arms [were] on this [side] and on that [side] at the place of the seat, and two lions [were] standing beside the arms.
en.B: The throne had six steps and a footstool of gold, fastened to the throne. On either side of the seat were armrests, with two lions standing beside the armrests.
en.R: The throne had six steps leading up to it, and a gold footstool was attached to it. On each side of the seat was an armrest, and a lion statue stood beside each armrest.

es.L: Y seis gradas [tenía] el trono, y un estrado de oro [estaba] sujeto al trono, y [había] brazos a uno y otro lado del asiento, y dos leones de pie junto a los brazos.
es.B: El trono tenía seis gradas y un estrado de oro sujeto al trono. A ambos lados del asiento había brazos, y junto a los brazos había dos leones de pie.
es.R: El trono tenía seis escalones para subir a él, y un estrado de oro estaba unido a él. Había brazos a los dos lados del asiento, y junto a cada brazo había la estatua de un león.

fr.L: Et six marches [menaient] au trône, et un marchepied d’or [était] au trône, fixé [à lui], et des bras [étaient] de ce côté-ci et de ce côté-là du siège, et deux lions se tenaient à côté des bras.
fr.B: Le trône avait six marches et un marchepied d’or fixé au trône. De chaque côté du siège, il y avait des accoudoirs, et deux lions se tenaient à côté des accoudoirs.
fr.R: Le trône avait six marches pour y monter, et un marchepied en or y était attaché. Il y avait des accoudoirs des deux côtés du siège, et une statue de lion se tenait à côté de chaque accoudoir.

sw.L: Na ngazi sita [zilikuwa] za kiti cha enzi, na kibao cha kuwekea miguu cha dhahabu [kilikuwa] cha kiti cha enzi, kimeungwa [nacho], na mikono upande huu na upande huu wa mahali pa kuketi, na simba wawili wamesimama kando ya mikono.
sw.B: Kiti cha enzi kilikuwa na ngazi sita na kibao cha dhahabu cha kuwekea miguu, kilichoungwa na kiti cha enzi. Pande zote mbili za kiti kulikuwa na mahali pa kuegemeza mikono, na simba wawili walisimama kando yake.
sw.R: Kiti cha enzi kilikuwa na ngazi sita za kukipandia, na kibao cha dhahabu cha kuwekea miguu kilikuwa kimeungwa nacho. Kulikuwa na mahali pa kuegemeza mikono pande zote mbili za kiti, na sanamu ya simba ilisimama kando ya kila moja.

vi.L: Ngai có sáu bậc, và một cái bệ chân bằng vàng [gắn] vào ngai, được gắn chặt; hai bên chỗ ngồi có tay vịn, và hai con sư tử đứng bên cạnh tay vịn.
vi.B: Ngai có sáu bậc và một cái bệ chân bằng vàng gắn liền với ngai. Hai bên chỗ ngồi có tay vịn, và có hai con sư tử đứng bên cạnh tay vịn.
vi.R: Có sáu bậc dẫn lên ngai, và một cái bệ để chân bằng vàng gắn liền với ngai. Hai bên chỗ ngồi có tay vịn, và bên cạnh mỗi tay vịn có một tượng sư tử đứng.

ko.L: 그리고 왕좌에는 계단이 여섯 개 있었고, 왕좌에 금 발판이 붙어 있었으며, 앉는 자리 이쪽과 저쪽에 팔걸이가 있었고, 팔걸이 곁에는 사자 두 마리가 서 있었다.
ko.B: 왕좌에는 계단이 여섯 개 있었고, 왕좌에 붙은 금 발판이 있었다. 앉는 자리 양쪽에는 팔걸이가 있었고, 팔걸이 옆에는 사자 두 마리가 서 있었다.
ko.R: 왕좌로 올라가는 계단은 여섯 개였고, 왕좌에는 금 발판이 붙어 있었다. 앉는 자리 양쪽에는 팔걸이가 있었고, 팔걸이마다 옆에 사자상이 하나씩 서 있었다.

pt.L: E seis degraus [havia] para o trono, e um estrado de ouro [havia] para o trono, presos [a ele], e braços [havia] deste [lado] e daquele [lado] no lugar do assento, e dois leões [estavam] de pé junto aos braços.
pt.B: O trono tinha seis degraus e um estrado de ouro para os pés, preso ao trono. Dos dois lados do assento havia braços, e dois leões ficavam de pé junto aos braços.
pt.R: O trono tinha seis degraus que subiam até ele, e um estrado de ouro para os pés estava preso a ele. Havia um braço de cada lado do assento, e uma estátua de leão ficava ao lado de cada braço.

decisions.choice: a footstool of gold: where 1 Kings 10:19 has "a round top behind it"
decisions.reason: Kings describes the throne's rounded back; Chronicles names a gold footstool instead. The two accounts may each mention a different part of the same throne, or one text may have been changed in copying. The rest of the description is the same.

decisions.choice: fastened: the footstool and steps were joined to the throne
alternatives: the steps and footstool were fastened together
decisions.reason: The word is plural and means "held fast" or "attached". It most likely says that the footstool (with the steps) was fixed to the throne rather than standing loose.

decisions.choice: hands: armrests
decisions.reason: The "hands" of a chair are its arms, the parts on which the sitter's hands rest.

decisions.choice: two lions: a symbol of royal power
decisions.reason: Lions often stood beside royal thrones in the ancient world; the lion was also the emblem of Judah, Solomon's tribe (Genesis 49:9).

decisions.choice: a lion statue stood beside each armrest
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the lions were carved figures, one at each side.

decisions.choice: "un estrado de oro"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names a gold footstool where 1 Kings 10:19 describes a rounded back (meaning decision); the rest keeps the Spanish Kings wording.

decisions.choice: kibao cha kuwekea miguu
decisions.reason: Chronicles names a footstool where 1 Kings 10:19 has a rounded top (m1); "kibao cha kuwekea miguu" says what it was.

decisions.choice: "bệ chân bằng vàng"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has a gold footstool where 1 Kings 10:19 has a round top (m1).

decisions.choice: um estrado de ouro (para os pés); presos (L), preso (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names a gold footstool where Kings has a rounded top (m1); Portuguese says "estrado para os pés". The rest keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 10:19.

source.text: וּשְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲרָי֗וֹת עֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֛ם עַל־שֵׁ֥שׁ הַֽמַּעֲל֖וֹת מִזֶּ֣ה וּמִזֶּ֑ה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן לְכָל־מַמְלָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And two [and] ten lions standing there on [the] six the steps, from this and from this; not was made thus for any kingdom.

en.L: And twelve lions [were] standing there on the six steps, on this [side] and on that [side]; nothing like it was made for any kingdom.
en.B: Twelve lions stood there on the six steps, one at each end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any kingdom.
en.R: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at each end of every step. No other kingdom had ever had a throne like it.

es.L: Y doce leones estaban allí sobre las seis gradas, a uno y otro lado; no se hizo cosa semejante para ningún reino.
es.B: Doce leones estaban allí sobre las seis gradas, uno a cada extremo de cada grada. Nunca se había hecho algo así para ningún reino.
es.R: Doce leones estaban sobre los seis escalones, uno a cada extremo de cada escalón. Ningún otro reino había tenido jamás un trono como ese.

fr.L: Et douze lions se tenaient là sur les six marches, de ce côté-ci et de ce côté-là ; il ne s’en fit pas de pareil pour aucun royaume.
fr.B: Douze lions se tenaient là sur les six marches, un à chaque bout de chaque marche. Rien de pareil n’avait jamais été fait pour aucun royaume.
fr.R: Douze lions se tenaient sur les six marches, un à chaque bout de chaque marche. Aucun autre royaume n’avait jamais eu un trône comme celui-là.

sw.L: Na simba kumi na wawili [walikuwa] wamesimama huko juu ya ngazi sita, upande huu na upande huu; hakikufanywa kitu kama hicho katika ufalme wowote.
sw.B: Simba kumi na wawili walisimama huko juu ya ngazi sita, mmoja kila mwisho wa kila ngazi. Hakuna kitu kama hicho kilichowahi kufanywa kwa ufalme wowote.
sw.R: Simba kumi na wawili walisimama juu ya ngazi sita, mmoja kila mwisho wa kila ngazi. Hakuna ufalme mwingine uliowahi kuwa na kiti cha enzi kama hicho.

vi.L: Mười hai con sư tử đứng đó trên sáu bậc, bên này và bên kia; không có ngai nào như vậy được làm cho bất cứ vương quốc nào.
vi.B: Mười hai con sư tử đứng trên sáu bậc, mỗi đầu bậc một con. Chưa từng có ngai nào như vậy được làm cho bất cứ vương quốc nào.
vi.R: Mười hai con sư tử đứng trên sáu bậc, mỗi đầu bậc một con. Không có vương quốc nào khác từng có một cái ngai như vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 여섯 계단 위 이쪽과 저쪽에 사자 열두 마리가 서 있었다. 어느 나라에서도 이와 같은 것을 만든 적이 없었다.
ko.B: 여섯 계단 양쪽 끝에는 사자 열두 마리가 서 있었다. 어느 나라에서도 이런 왕좌를 만든 적이 없었다.
ko.R: 여섯 계단의 양쪽 끝마다 사자상이 하나씩, 모두 열두 개가 서 있었다. 다른 어느 나라에도 이런 왕좌는 없었다.

pt.L: E doze leões [estavam] de pé ali sobre os seis degraus, deste [lado] e daquele [lado]; nada semelhante foi feito para nenhum reino.
pt.B: Doze leões ficavam ali sobre os seis degraus, um em cada ponta de cada degrau. Nada semelhante tinha sido feito em nenhum outro reino.
pt.R: Doze leões ficavam sobre os seis degraus, um em cada ponta de cada degrau. Nenhum outro reino jamais teve um trono como aquele.

decisions.choice: twelve lions on the six steps, on this side and on that: a lion at each end of each step
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:20, which this verse repeats, six steps with a lion on either side make twelve, besides the two beside the armrests (verse 18).

decisions.choice: nothing like it was made for any kingdom: the throne was without equal
decisions.reason: The phrase claims that no other king had such a throne, part of the picture of Solomon's surpassing glory (verse 22).

decisions.choice: one at each end of each step
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the Hebrew "from this and from this", which means on both sides of each step.

source.text: וְ֠כֹל כְּלֵ֞י מַשְׁקֵ֨ה הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ זָהָ֔ב וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י בֵּֽית־יַ֥עַר הַלְּבָנ֖וֹן זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר אֵ֣ין כֶּ֗סֶף נֶחְשָׁ֛ב בִּימֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לִמְאֽוּמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] vessels of drinking of the king Solomon [were] gold, and all [the] vessels of [the] house of [the] forest of the Lebanon [were] gold pure; not silver [was] reckoned in [the] days of Solomon as anything.

en.L: And all the drinking vessels of King Solomon [were] gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon [were] pure gold; silver was not reckoned as anything in the days of Solomon.
en.B: All King Solomon's drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils in the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. In Solomon's days silver was not thought of as anything.
en.R: All of King Solomon's cups were made of gold, and all the dishes in the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. In Solomon's time silver was hardly worth anything.

es.L: Y todos los vasos de beber del rey Salomón [eran] de oro, y todos los utensilios de la Casa del Bosque del Líbano [eran] de oro puro; la plata no era estimada en nada en los días de Salomón.
es.B: Todas las copas del rey Salomón eran de oro, y todos los utensilios de la Casa del Bosque del Líbano eran de oro puro. En los días de Salomón la plata no se estimaba en nada.
es.R: Todas las copas del rey Salomón eran de oro, y todos los platos de la Casa del Bosque del Líbano eran de oro puro. En el tiempo de Salomón la plata casi no valía nada.

fr.L: Et tous les vases à boire du roi Salomon [étaient] d’or, et tous les objets de la Maison de la Forêt du Liban [étaient] d’or pur ; on ne faisait aucun cas de l’argent aux jours de Salomon.
fr.B: Toutes les coupes du roi Salomon étaient en or, et tous les ustensiles de la Maison de la Forêt du Liban étaient en or pur. Du temps de Salomon, on ne faisait aucun cas de l’argent.
fr.R: Toutes les coupes du roi Salomon étaient en or, et toute la vaisselle de la Maison de la Forêt du Liban était en or pur. À l’époque de Salomon, l’argent n’avait presque aucune valeur.

sw.L: Na vyombo vyote vya kunywea vya mfalme Sulemani [vilikuwa vya] dhahabu, na vyombo vyote vya Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni [vilikuwa vya] dhahabu safi; fedha haikuhesabiwa kuwa kitu siku za Sulemani.
sw.B: Vikombe vyote vya kunywea vya mfalme Sulemani vilikuwa vya dhahabu, na vyombo vyote katika Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni vilikuwa vya dhahabu safi. Siku za Sulemani fedha haikuhesabiwa kuwa kitu.
sw.R: Vikombe vyote vya mfalme Sulemani vilikuwa vya dhahabu, na vyombo vyote katika Nyumba ya Msitu wa Lebanoni vilikuwa vya dhahabu safi. Wakati wa Sulemani fedha haikuwa na thamani kubwa.

vi.L: Tất cả chén uống của vua Sa-lô-môn [đều bằng] vàng, và tất cả các vật dụng trong Cung Rừng Li-ban [đều bằng] vàng ròng; vào thời Sa-lô-môn, bạc không được kể là gì cả.
vi.B: Tất cả chén uống của vua Sa-lô-môn đều bằng vàng, và mọi vật dụng trong Cung Rừng Li-ban đều bằng vàng ròng. Vào thời Sa-lô-môn bạc chẳng được coi ra gì.
vi.R: Tất cả chén của vua Sa-lô-môn đều làm bằng vàng, và mọi đồ dùng trong Cung Rừng Li-ban đều bằng vàng ròng. Vào thời Sa-lô-môn bạc gần như chẳng có giá trị gì.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬 왕이 마시는 그릇은 모두 금이었고, 레바논 숲의 집의 모든 그릇은 순금이었다. 솔로몬의 시대에는 은을 아무것도 아닌 것으로 여겼다.
ko.B: 솔로몬 왕이 쓰는 잔은 모두 금이었고, '레바논 숲 궁'의 그릇도 모두 순금이었다. 솔로몬 시대에는 은을 귀하게 여기지 않았다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕이 쓰는 잔은 모두 금으로 만들었고, '레바논 숲 궁'의 그릇도 모두 순금이었다. 솔로몬 시대에는 은이 거의 값어치가 없었다.

pt.L: E todos os utensílios de beber do rei Salomão [eram de] ouro, e todos os utensílios da casa da floresta do Líbano [eram de] ouro puro; a prata não era considerada coisa alguma nos dias de Salomão.
pt.B: Todas as taças do rei Salomão eram de ouro, e todos os utensílios da Casa da Floresta do Líbano eram de ouro puro. Nos dias de Salomão a prata não era considerada coisa alguma.
pt.R: Todas as taças do rei Salomão eram feitas de ouro, e todos os pratos da Casa da Floresta do Líbano eram de ouro puro. No tempo de Salomão a prata quase não tinha valor.

decisions.choice: pure gold: gold of the best quality
decisions.reason: The word describes gold that has been refined. It is used of the gold in the temple (4:20-22).

decisions.choice: silver was not reckoned as anything: there was so much wealth that silver seemed cheap
decisions.reason: A deliberate overstatement, like verse 27: silver was so common in Solomon's days that it counted for nothing.

decisions.choice: a difference from 1 Kings 10:21
decisions.reason: Kings says "there was no silver; it was not reckoned as anything". Chronicles has the shorter "silver was not reckoned as anything", though its words can also be read "none was silver; it was reckoned ...". Either way the point is the same: none of the king's vessels were silver, because silver counted for so little.

decisions.choice: hardly worth anything
decisions.reason: Readable puts "not reckoned as anything" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: a prata não era considerada coisa alguma
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the shorter "silver was not reckoned as anything" (m3), so the Portuguese of 1 Kings 10:21 leaves out "não havia prata" / "Nenhum era de prata".

source.text: כִּֽי־אֳנִיּ֤וֹת לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הֹלְכ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ עִ֖ם עַבְדֵ֣י חוּרָ֑ם אַחַת֩ לְשָׁל֨וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹאנָה׀אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ נֹֽשְׂאוֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֔סֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּ֥ים וְקוֹפִ֖ים וְתוּכִּיִּֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For ships [were] to the king going [to] Tarshish with [the] servants of Huram; once in three years would come [the] ships of Tarshish carrying gold and silver, ivories, and apes, and peacocks.

en.L: For the king had ships going [to] Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once in three years the ships of Tarshish would come, carrying gold and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
en.B: For the king had ships that sailed to Tarshish with Huram's servants. Once every three years the Tarshish ships would come in, bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes and peacocks.
en.R: This was because the king had ships that sailed to Tarshish with Huram's men. Once every three years these large trading ships came back loaded with gold, silver, ivory, apes and peacocks.

es.L: Porque el rey tenía naves que iban [a] Tarsis con los siervos de Huram; una vez cada tres años venían las naves de Tarsis trayendo oro y plata, marfil, monos y pavos reales.
es.B: Porque el rey tenía naves que iban a Tarsis con los siervos de Huram. Una vez cada tres años llegaban las naves de Tarsis trayendo oro, plata, marfil, monos y pavos reales.
es.R: Esto era porque el rey tenía barcos que navegaban hasta Tarsis con los hombres de Huram. Una vez cada tres años estos grandes barcos de comercio volvían cargados de oro, plata, marfil, monos y pavos reales.

fr.L: Car le roi avait des navires qui allaient [à] Tarsis avec les serviteurs de Houram ; une fois tous les trois ans, les navires de Tarsis venaient, apportant de l’or et de l’argent, de l’ivoire, et des singes, et des paons.
fr.B: Car le roi avait des navires qui allaient à Tarsis avec les serviteurs de Houram. Une fois tous les trois ans, les navires de Tarsis arrivaient, chargés d’or, d’argent, d’ivoire, de singes et de paons.

sw.B: Kwa maana mfalme alikuwa na merikebu zilizosafiri mpaka Tarshishi pamoja na watumishi wa Huramu. Mara moja kila miaka mitatu merikebu hizo za Tarshishi zilifika zikileta dhahabu, fedha, pembe za ndovu, nyani na tausi.
sw.R: Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu mfalme alikuwa na merikebu zilizosafiri mpaka Tarshishi pamoja na watu wa Huramu. Mara moja kila miaka mitatu merikebu hizo kubwa za biashara zilirudi zikiwa zimejaa dhahabu, fedha, pembe za ndovu, nyani na tausi.

vi.L: Vì vua có các tàu đi [đến] Ta-rê-si với các đầy tớ của Hu-ram; cứ ba năm một lần các tàu Ta-rê-si trở về, chở vàng, bạc, ngà voi, khỉ và chim công.

vi.R: Đó là vì vua có các tàu đi đến Ta-rê-si cùng với người của Hu-ram. Cứ ba năm một lần những tàu buôn lớn ấy trở về, chở đầy vàng, bạc, ngà voi, khỉ và chim công.

ko.L: 왕에게는 후람의 종들과 함께 다시스로 다니는 배들이 있었다. 삼 년에 한 번씩 다시스 배들이 금과 은과 상아와 원숭이와 공작을 싣고 들어왔다.
ko.B: 왕에게는 후람의 신하들과 함께 다시스로 다니는 배들이 있었다. 이 다시스 배들은 삼 년에 한 번씩 금과 은과 상아와 원숭이와 공작을 싣고 들어왔다.
ko.R: 왕에게는 후람의 사람들과 함께 다시스로 다니는 배들이 있었기 때문이다. 이 커다란 무역선들은 삼 년에 한 번씩 금과 은과 상아와 원숭이와 공작을 가득 싣고 돌아왔다.

pt.L: Porque o rei tinha navios que iam [a] Társis com os servos de Hurão; uma vez a cada três anos vinham os navios de Társis, trazendo ouro e prata, marfim, e macacos, e pavões.
pt.B: Pois o rei tinha navios que iam a Társis com os servos de Hurão. Uma vez a cada três anos os navios de Társis chegavam, trazendo ouro, prata, marfim, macacos e pavões.
pt.R: Isso porque o rei tinha navios que iam a Társis com os homens de Hurão. Uma vez a cada três anos esses grandes navios mercantes voltavam carregados de ouro, prata, marfim, macacos e pavões.

decisions.choice: ships going to Tarshish with Huram's servants: a difference from 1 Kings 10:22
decisions.reason: Kings says the king had "ships of Tarshish" at sea "with the ships of Hiram". "Ships of Tarshish" was a name for large seagoing merchant ships, whatever their route; Jehoshaphat built such ships to go to Ophir (1 Kings 22:49). Chronicles says the ships were "going to Tarshish", a far-off port probably in the far west of the Mediterranean (Jonah 1:3), and it names Huram's sailors rather than his ships. It may take Tarshish as the destination, or use "going to Tarshish" for the long voyages such ships made; the second half of the verse still calls them "ships of Tarshish".

decisions.choice: once in three years: a voyage that took three years to complete
decisions.reason: The ships came back once every three years, which suggests long voyages to distant places.

decisions.choice: ivory, apes, and peacocks: exotic goods whose names are not all certain
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:22, the word for ivory seems to mean "elephant tooth" and the word taken as "apes" names some kind of monkey. The last word appears only here and in Kings; it has long been taken as peacocks, but it may name baboons or another animal.

decisions.choice: This was because; Huram's men; these large trading ships
decisions.reason: Readable makes the "for" explicit as the reason for Solomon's wealth in gold, says "men" for the sailors, as in verse 10, and explains "ships of Tarshish" by the kind of ship they were.

decisions.choice: "naves que iban a Tarsis"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says ships "going to Tarshish" where 1 Kings 10:22 has "ships of Tarshish" (meaning decision); Spanish follows the Hebrew of each book.

decisions.choice: "các tàu đi đến Ta-rê-si"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says the ships went to Tarshish (m1), where 1 Kings 10:22 speaks of "ships of Tarshish"; the name follows the terms note.

decisions.choice: "다시스로 다니는 배들"; "다시스 배" (L, B), "커다란 무역선" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says the ships went to Tarshish; Readable keeps 1 Kings 10:22's explanation of "ships of Tarshish".

decisions.choice: navios que iam a Társis com os servos de Hurão
alternatives: navios de Társis no mar com os navios de Hirão (1 Kings 10:22)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has ships "going to Tarshish" with Huram's servants (m1); the rest keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 10:22, with "Hurão" as in 8:2.

records.literal_gloss: And became great the king Solomon more than all [the] kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

en.L: And King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.
en.B: So King Solomon grew greater in riches and in wisdom than all the kings of the earth.
en.R: King Solomon became richer and wiser than any other king on earth.

es.L: Y el rey Salomón fue más grande que todos los reyes de la tierra en riquezas y en sabiduría.
es.B: Así el rey Salomón llegó a ser más grande en riquezas y en sabiduría que todos los reyes de la tierra.
es.R: El rey Salomón llegó a ser más rico y más sabio que cualquier otro rey de la tierra.

fr.L: Et le roi Salomon fut plus grand que tous les rois de la terre en richesse et en sagesse.
fr.B: Ainsi le roi Salomon surpassa tous les rois de la terre en richesse et en sagesse.
fr.R: Le roi Salomon est devenu plus riche et plus sage que tous les autres rois de la terre.

sw.L: Mfalme Sulemani akawa mkuu kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia kwa mali na hekima.
sw.B: Basi mfalme Sulemani akawazidi wafalme wote wa dunia kwa utajiri na kwa hekima.
sw.R: Mfalme Sulemani alikuwa tajiri zaidi na mwenye hekima zaidi kuliko mfalme mwingine yeyote duniani.

vi.L: Vua Sa-lô-môn trở nên lớn hơn tất cả các vua trên đất về sự giàu có và sự khôn ngoan.
vi.B: Vậy vua Sa-lô-môn giàu có và khôn ngoan hơn tất cả các vua trên đất.
vi.R: Vua Sa-lô-môn giàu có và khôn ngoan hơn mọi vua khác trên đất.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬 왕은 부와 지혜에서 세상의 모든 왕보다 컸다.
ko.B: 이렇게 솔로몬 왕은 부와 지혜에서 세상의 어느 왕보다도 뛰어났다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕은 세상의 어느 왕보다도 더 부유하고 더 지혜로웠다.

pt.L: E o rei Salomão se tornou maior que todos os reis da terra em riqueza e sabedoria.
pt.B: Assim o rei Salomão se tornou maior em riqueza e em sabedoria do que todos os reis da terra.
pt.R: O rei Salomão ficou mais rico e mais sábio do que qualquer outro rei do mundo.

decisions.choice: wealth and wisdom: what God promised at Gibeon
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 1 Kings 10:23. Solomon had asked for wisdom, and God promised him riches and honor as well, such as no king before or after him would have (1:11-12). This verse records that the promise was kept.

decisions.choice: became greater: Solomon grew to surpass all other kings
decisions.reason: The verb describes Solomon growing great, a process seen through the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: richer and wiser
decisions.reason: Readable turns the two nouns into adjectives, the plainest way to say the same thing.

source.text: וְכֹל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה לִשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת־חָכְמָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] kings of the earth [were] seeking [the] face of Solomon to hear his wisdom which put God in his heart.

en.L: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
en.B: All the kings of the earth sought an audience with Solomon, to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
en.R: Kings from all over the world wanted to meet Solomon and hear the wisdom God had given him.

es.L: Y todos los reyes de la tierra buscaban el rostro de Salomón para oír su sabiduría, que Dios había puesto en su corazón.
es.B: Todos los reyes de la tierra procuraban ser recibidos por Salomón para oír la sabiduría que Dios había puesto en su corazón.
es.R: Reyes de todo el mundo querían conocer a Salomón y oír la sabiduría que Dios le había dado.

fr.L: Et tous les rois de la terre cherchaient la face de Salomon pour entendre sa sagesse, que Dieu avait mise dans son cœur.
fr.B: Tous les rois de la terre cherchaient à être reçus par Salomon, pour entendre la sagesse que Dieu avait mise dans son cœur.
fr.R: Des rois du monde entier voulaient rencontrer Salomon et entendre la sagesse que Dieu lui avait donnée.

sw.L: Na wafalme wote wa dunia walikuwa wakiutafuta uso wa Sulemani ili kusikia hekima yake, ambayo Mungu aliiweka moyoni mwake.
sw.B: Wafalme wote wa dunia walitafuta kuonana na Sulemani, ili kusikia hekima ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameiweka moyoni mwake.
sw.R: Wafalme kutoka kila sehemu ya dunia walitaka kumwona Sulemani na kusikia hekima ambayo Mungu alimpa.

vi.L: Tất cả các vua trên đất tìm kiếm mặt Sa-lô-môn để nghe sự khôn ngoan Đức Chúa Trời đã đặt trong lòng vua.
vi.B: Tất cả các vua trên đất đều tìm đến yết kiến Sa-lô-môn để nghe sự khôn ngoan Đức Chúa Trời đã đặt trong lòng vua.
vi.R: Các vua từ khắp nơi trên thế giới muốn đến gặp Sa-lô-môn và nghe sự khôn ngoan Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho vua.

ko.L: 그리고 세상의 모든 왕이 하나님께서 그의 마음에 두신 지혜를 들으려고 솔로몬의 얼굴을 찾았다.
ko.B: 세상의 모든 왕이 하나님께서 솔로몬의 마음에 주신 지혜를 들으려고 그를 만나기를 원했다.
ko.R: 세상 곳곳의 왕들이 솔로몬을 만나서 하나님께서 그에게 주신 지혜로운 말을 듣고 싶어 했다.

pt.L: E todos os reis da terra buscavam a face de Salomão para ouvir a sua sabedoria, que Deus tinha posto no seu coração.
pt.B: Todos os reis da terra procuravam uma audiência com Salomão, para ouvir a sabedoria que Deus tinha posto no coração dele.
pt.R: Reis do mundo inteiro queriam encontrar Salomão e ouvir a sabedoria que Deus tinha dado a ele.

decisions.choice: all the kings of the earth: where 1 Kings 10:24 has "all the earth"
decisions.reason: Kings says the whole earth sought Solomon; Chronicles says the kings of the earth did, picking up "the kings of the earth" from verse 22. The rest of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: seeking the face of Solomon: asking to come before him
decisions.reason: To seek a king's face is to seek an audience with him (Proverbs 29:26).

decisions.choice: the wisdom God had put in his heart: wisdom as a gift
decisions.reason: Solomon's wisdom is not his own achievement. God gave it, as he promised (1:12). The heart is the seat of understanding.

decisions.choice: sought an audience (Balanced); wanted to meet (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the idiom of seeking his face.

decisions.choice: todos os reis da terra
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "all the kings of the earth" where Kings says "all the earth" (m1); the rest keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 10:24.

records.literal_gloss: And they [were] bringing each his gift, articles of silver and articles of gold, and garments, weaponry, and spices, horses and mules, [the] matter of [a] year in [a] year.

en.L: And they were bringing, each his gift: articles of silver and articles of gold, and garments, weapons, and spices, horses and mules, a year's portion year by year.
en.B: Each of them brought a gift: articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, horses and mules, so much every year.
en.R: Year after year, each of them brought him gifts: things made of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses and mules.

es.L: Y ellos traían cada uno su presente: objetos de plata y objetos de oro, y vestidos, armas, y especias, caballos y mulas, lo de cada año, año tras año.
es.B: Cada uno le llevaba un regalo: objetos de plata y de oro, ropas, armas y especias, caballos y mulas, tanto cada año.
es.R: Año tras año, cada uno de ellos le llevaba regalos: cosas hechas de plata y de oro, ropa, armas, especias, caballos y mulas.

fr.L: Et ils apportaient chacun son présent : des objets d’argent et des objets d’or, et des vêtements, des armes, et des aromates, des chevaux et des mulets, la part d’une année, année après année.
fr.B: Chacun apportait son présent : des objets d’argent et d’or, des vêtements, des armes et des aromates, des chevaux et des mulets ; il en était ainsi chaque année.
fr.R: Année après année, chacun d’eux lui apportait des cadeaux : des objets en argent et en or, des vêtements, des armes, des épices, des chevaux et des mulets.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakileta, kila mtu zawadi yake: vyombo vya fedha na vyombo vya dhahabu, na mavazi, silaha, na manukato, farasi na nyumbu, sehemu ya mwaka mwaka kwa mwaka.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wao alileta zawadi: vyombo vya fedha na dhahabu, mavazi, silaha na manukato, farasi na nyumbu, kiasi fulani kila mwaka.
sw.R: Mwaka baada ya mwaka, kila mmoja wao alimletea zawadi: vitu vilivyotengenezwa kwa fedha na dhahabu, mavazi, silaha, manukato, farasi na nyumbu.

vi.L: Họ đem đến, mỗi người một lễ vật: đồ bằng bạc và đồ bằng vàng, y phục, vũ khí, hương liệu, ngựa và la, năm này qua năm khác.
vi.B: Mỗi người đều đem lễ vật đến: đồ bằng bạc và vàng, áo choàng, vũ khí và hương liệu, ngựa và la, năm nào cũng vậy.
vi.R: Năm này qua năm khác, mỗi người đều đem quà tặng vua: đồ bằng bạc và vàng, quần áo, vũ khí, hương liệu, ngựa và la.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 각자 자기 예물, 곧 은그릇과 금그릇과 옷과 무기와 향료와 말과 노새를 해마다 정한 몫대로 가져왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 저마다 은그릇과 금그릇과 옷과 무기와 향료와 말과 노새를 예물로 가져왔는데, 해마다 그렇게 했다.
ko.R: 해마다 그들은 저마다 은과 금으로 만든 물건과 옷과 무기와 향료와 말과 노새를 그에게 선물로 가져왔다.

pt.L: E eles traziam, cada um o seu presente: objetos de prata e objetos de ouro, e vestes, armas, e especiarias, cavalos e mulas, a porção de um ano, ano após ano.
pt.B: Cada um deles trazia um presente: objetos de prata e de ouro, mantos, armas e especiarias, cavalos e mulas, uma quantia certa a cada ano.
pt.R: Ano após ano, cada um deles trazia presentes para ele: objetos de prata e de ouro, roupas, armas, especiarias, cavalos e mulas.

decisions.choice: were bringing, year by year: a regular yearly practice
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:25, which this verse repeats, the verb form describes a continuing custom, and "the matter of a year in a year" means a fixed amount each year. In Chronicles "they" are the kings of verse 23.

decisions.choice: his gift: an offering to honor the king
decisions.reason: The word is the common word for a gift or offering, used also of tribute paid to a ruler (17:11; Judges 3:15). Those who came to hear Solomon's wisdom came with gifts, as the queen of Sheba did.

decisions.choice: so much every year (Balanced); Year after year (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express the Hebrew "the matter of a year in a year" in plain English.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י לִשְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אַרְבַּעַת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אֻֽרְי֤וֹת סוּסִים֙ וּמַרְכָּב֔וֹת וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And were to Solomon four thousand stalls [of] horses and chariots, and two [and] ten thousand horsemen; and he stationed them in [the] cities of the chariotry and with the king in Jerusalem.

en.L: And Solomon had 4,000 stalls of horses and chariots, and 12,000 horsemen; and he stationed them in the cities of the chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.B: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots, and he had 12,000 horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.R: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his horses and chariots, and he had 12,000 horsemen. He kept some of them in the cities where his chariots were based, and some with him in Jerusalem.

es.L: Y tenía Salomón 4 000 establos de caballos y carros, y 12 000 jinetes; y los puso en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.B: Salomón tenía 4 000 establos para caballos y carros, y 12 000 jinetes, que estacionó en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.R: Salomón tenía 4 000 establos para sus caballos y carros, y tenía 12 000 jinetes. A algunos los tenía en las ciudades donde estaban sus carros, y a otros con él en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et Salomon avait 4 000 stalles de chevaux et de chars, et 12 000 cavaliers ; et il les plaça dans les villes des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Salomon avait 4 000 stalles pour les chevaux et les chars, et 12 000 cavaliers, qu’il installa dans les villes de garnison des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Salomon avait 4 000 places dans ses écuries pour ses chevaux et ses chars, et il avait 12 000 cavaliers. Il en a gardé une partie dans les villes où étaient basés ses chars, et une partie avec lui à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Sulemani alikuwa na mabanda 4,000 ya farasi na magari ya vita, na wapanda farasi 12,000; akawaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Sulemani alikuwa na mabanda 4,000 ya farasi na magari ya vita, na wapanda farasi 12,000, aliowaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Sulemani alikuwa na mabanda 4,000 ya farasi wake na magari yake ya vita, na wapanda farasi 12,000. Aliweka baadhi yao katika miji yalimokaa magari yake ya vita, na wengine pamoja naye huko Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn có 4.000 chuồng ngựa và xe chiến mã, và 12.000 kỵ binh; vua đóng họ trong các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn có 4.000 chuồng cho ngựa và xe chiến mã, và có 12.000 kỵ binh, đóng tại các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn có 4.000 chuồng cho ngựa và xe chiến mã của vua, và có 12.000 kỵ binh. Vua để một số ở các thành đóng quân xe chiến mã, và một số ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬에게는 말과 병거를 두는 마구간 4천 개와 기병 1만 2천 명이 있었다. 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬에게는 말과 병거를 두는 마구간이 4천 개 있었고, 기병이 1만 2천 명 있었는데, 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬에게는 말과 병거를 두는 마구간이 4천 개 있었고, 기병이 1만 2천 명 있었다. 그는 그들 가운데 일부는 병거를 두는 성읍들에, 일부는 예루살렘에 자기 곁에 두었다.

pt.L: E Salomão tinha quatro mil baias de cavalos e carros, e doze mil cavaleiros; e ele os alojou nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Salomão tinha quatro mil baias para cavalos e carros, e tinha doze mil cavaleiros, que ele mantinha nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Salomão tinha quatro mil baias para os seus cavalos e carros, e tinha doze mil cavaleiros. Deixou uma parte deles nas cidades onde ficavam os seus carros, e outra parte com ele em Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: 4,000 stalls, as the Hebrew text of Chronicles reads
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 5:6, which this verse echoes, has 40,000 stalls. The smaller number here fits the 1,400 chariots of 1 Kings 10:26 and 2 Chronicles 1:14 better. A copyist may have changed one of the numbers; see the note at 1 Kings 5:6.

decisions.choice: this verse joins 1 Kings 5:6 and 10:26
decisions.reason: Where 1 Kings 10:26 counts Solomon's 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, Chronicles gives the stalls and horsemen from 1 Kings 5:6, then follows 10:26 in placing them in the chariot cities and in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: horsemen: the men who rode or drove, or perhaps the horses themselves
decisions.reason: The word usually means horsemen, but it can also mean horses for chariots, as the note at 1 Kings 5:6 explains.

decisions.choice: the chariot cities: towns with stables and barracks for the chariot force
decisions.reason: Solomon built store cities and towns for his chariots and horsemen (8:6).

decisions.choice: some ... and some with him
decisions.reason: Readable says that the force was divided between the chariot cities and Jerusalem, and says "with him" for "with the king", since the king is Solomon.

decisions.choice: "4 000" (every level)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has 4,000 stalls where 1 Kings 5:6 has 40,000 (meaning decision); the number is in figures at every level, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 10:26.

decisions.choice: quatro mil baias; doze mil cavaleiros; as cidades dos carros
decisions.reason: The verse joins 1 Kings 5:6 and 10:26 (m2) and keeps their Portuguese ("baias", "cavaleiros", "as cidades dos carros"), with the 4,000 stalls the Hebrew of Chronicles reads (m1), written in words as a round number.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־הַמְּלָכִ֑ים מִן־הַנָּהָר֙ וְעַד־אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְעַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he was ruling over all the kings from the River and to [the] land of [the] Philistines and to [the] border of Egypt.

en.L: And he was ruling over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines and as far as the border of Egypt.
en.B: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines and as far as the border of Egypt.
en.R: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines and all the way to the border of Egypt.

es.L: Y dominaba sobre todos los reyes desde el Río hasta la tierra de los filisteos y hasta la frontera de Egipto.
es.B: Gobernaba sobre todos los reyes desde el río Éufrates hasta la tierra de los filisteos y hasta la frontera de Egipto.
es.R: Gobernaba sobre todos los reyes desde el río Éufrates hasta la tierra de los filisteos y hasta la frontera de Egipto.

fr.L: Et il dominait sur tous les rois depuis le Fleuve jusqu’au pays des Philistins et jusqu’à la frontière de l’Égypte.
fr.B: Il dominait sur tous les rois, depuis l’Euphrate jusqu’au pays des Philistins et jusqu’à la frontière de l’Égypte.
fr.R: Il régnait sur tous les rois depuis le fleuve Euphrate jusqu’au pays des Philistins, et jusqu’à la frontière de l’Égypte.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akitawala juu ya wafalme wote tangu Mto mpaka nchi ya Wafilisti na mpaka mpaka wa Misri.
sw.B: Alitawala juu ya wafalme wote tangu Mto Frati mpaka nchi ya Wafilisti, hata mpakani mwa Misri.
sw.R: Alitawala juu ya wafalme wote tangu Mto Frati mpaka nchi ya Wafilisti, hata kufika mpakani mwa Misri.

vi.L: Vua cai trị trên tất cả các vua từ Sông cho đến xứ Phi-li-tin và đến biên giới Ai Cập.
vi.B: Vua cai trị trên tất cả các vua từ sông Ơ-phơ-rát cho đến xứ Phi-li-tin và đến tận biên giới Ai Cập.
vi.R: Vua cai trị trên tất cả các vua từ sông Ơ-phơ-rát cho đến xứ Phi-li-tin và đến tận biên giới Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 강에서부터 블레셋 사람들의 땅과 이집트 국경에 이르기까지 모든 왕을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 그는 유프라테스강에서부터 블레셋 사람들의 땅과 이집트 국경에 이르기까지 모든 왕을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 그는 유프라테스강에서부터 블레셋 사람들의 땅을 지나 이집트 국경에 이르기까지 모든 왕을 다스렸다.

pt.L: E ele dominava sobre todos os reis desde o Rio até a terra dos filisteus e até a fronteira do Egito.
pt.B: Ele governava todos os reis desde o rio Eufrates até a terra dos filisteus e até a fronteira do Egito.
pt.R: Ele governava todos os reis desde o rio Eufrates até a terra dos filisteus, e até a fronteira do Egito.

decisions.choice: the same rule as 1 Kings 5:1
decisions.reason: Kings says Solomon ruled over "all the kingdoms"; Chronicles says "all the kings", and has "to" before "the land of the Philistines", which Kings leaves out. Kings goes on to say that they brought tribute; Chronicles has said so already (verses 23-24).

decisions.choice: the River: the Euphrates
decisions.reason: "The River" with the article names the Euphrates, as in the promise of the land to Abraham (Genesis 15:18). Solomon's rule reached the borders that promise named.

decisions.choice: the Euphrates River (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:1, Balanced and Readable name the river so that readers know which one "the River" means.

decisions.choice: "el Río" (L); "el río Éufrates" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 5:1: Literal keeps "the River", Balanced and Readable name it.

decisions.choice: "Sông" (L); "sông Ơ-phơ-rát" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 5:1: Literal keeps "the River", Balanced and Readable name it (m2).

decisions.choice: "유프라테스강" (B, R) for "the River"
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable; the name is spelled as in the published Genesis and Revelation.

decisions.choice: todos os reis; o Rio (L), o rio Eufrates (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 5:1 (4:21 in many Bibles), with Chronicles' "kings" for "kingdoms" and its "até" before the land of the Philistines, which Literal no longer needs to bracket (m1).

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּ֛סֶף בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And made the king the silver in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores which [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.

en.L: And the king made the silver in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores that [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.
en.B: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah.
en.R: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones. Cedar wood became as plentiful as the fig trees that grow in the western foothills.

es.L: E hizo el rey que en Jerusalén la plata fuera como piedras, y los cedros los hizo como los sicómoros que [hay] en la Sefela, en abundancia.
es.B: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata fuera tan común como las piedras, y el cedro tan abundante como los sicómoros de la Sefela.
es.R: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata fuera tan común como las piedras. La madera de cedro llegó a ser tan abundante como las higueras que crecen en las colinas del oeste.

fr.L: Et le roi rendit l’argent à Jérusalem [aussi commun] que les pierres, et il rendit les cèdres [aussi nombreux] que les sycomores qui [sont] dans la Shéfela, en abondance.
fr.B: Le roi rendit l’argent aussi commun à Jérusalem que les pierres, et le cèdre aussi abondant que les sycomores de la Shéfela.
fr.R: Le roi a rendu l’argent aussi courant à Jérusalem que les pierres. Le bois de cèdre est devenu aussi abondant que les figuiers qui poussent dans les collines de l’ouest.

sw.L: Mfalme akaifanya fedha katika Yerusalemu kuwa kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa kama mikuyu iliyo katika Shefela, kwa wingi.
sw.B: Mfalme aliifanya fedha kuwa ya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa mingi kama mikuyu ya Shefela.
sw.R: Mfalme aliifanya fedha kuwa ya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe. Mbao za mierezi zikawa nyingi kama mikuyu inayoota katika vilima vya magharibi.

vi.L: Vua làm cho bạc tại Giê-ru-sa-lem như đá, và gỗ bá hương vua làm cho như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la, vì rất nhiều.
vi.B: Vua làm cho bạc ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá, và gỗ bá hương nhiều như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la.
vi.R: Vua làm cho bạc ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá. Gỗ bá hương cũng nhiều như cây sung mọc ở vùng đồi phía tây.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 예루살렘에서 은을 돌처럼 [흔하게] 만들었고, 백향목을 세펠라에 있는 돌무화과나무처럼 많게 했다.
ko.B: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은이 돌처럼 흔해졌고, 백향목은 세펠라의 돌무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.
ko.R: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은이 돌처럼 흔해졌다. 백향목도 서쪽 낮은 산지에서 자라는 무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.

pt.L: E o rei fez a prata em Jerusalém como as pedras, e os cedros ele fez como os sicômoros que [estão] na Sefelá, em abundância.
pt.B: O rei tornou a prata tão comum em Jerusalém como as pedras, e o cedro tão abundante como os sicômoros das colinas da Sefelá.
pt.R: O rei fez a prata ficar tão comum em Jerusalém como as pedras. A madeira de cedro ficou tão abundante como as figueiras que crescem nas colinas do oeste.

decisions.choice: like stones, like the sycamores: a deliberate overstatement
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 1 Kings 10:27 and 2 Chronicles 1:15. Silver and costly cedar from Lebanon became, with poetic exaggeration, as common as the most ordinary things in the land.

decisions.choice: the sycamores in the Shephelah: common fig trees of the low hills
decisions.reason: The sycamore fig bears small figs and gives cheap, ordinary timber (Amos 7:14). The Shephelah is the region of low hills between the coastal plain and the hill country of Judah.

decisions.choice: sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah (Balanced); fig trees that grow in the western foothills (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 10:27, the English "sycamore" names a different tree, so Balanced says "sycamore-fig"; Readable explains the Shephelah by where it lies.

source.text: וּמוֹצִיאִ֨ים סוּסִ֧ים מִמִּצְרַ֛יִם לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וּמִכָּל־הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And [they were] bringing out horses from Egypt for Solomon and from all the lands.

en.L: And they were bringing out horses from Egypt for Solomon, and from all the lands.
en.B: Horses were brought for Solomon from Egypt and from all the lands.
en.R: Solomon's horses were brought in from Egypt and from all the other lands.

es.L: Y traían caballos para Salomón de Egipto y de todas las tierras.
es.B: Para Salomón se traían caballos de Egipto y de todas las tierras.
es.R: Los caballos de Salomón se traían de Egipto y de todas las demás tierras.

fr.L: Et on faisait sortir pour Salomon des chevaux d’Égypte et de tous les pays.
fr.B: On amenait des chevaux pour Salomon d’Égypte et de tous les pays.
fr.R: Les chevaux de Salomon venaient d’Égypte et de tous les autres pays.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakimletea Sulemani farasi kutoka Misri, na kutoka nchi zote.
sw.B: Sulemani aliletewa farasi kutoka Misri na kutoka nchi zote.
sw.R: Farasi wa Sulemani waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka nchi nyingine zote.

vi.L: Người ta đưa ngựa từ Ai Cập và từ mọi xứ đến cho Sa-lô-môn.
vi.B: Ngựa được đưa đến cho Sa-lô-môn từ Ai Cập và từ mọi xứ.
vi.R: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được đem về từ Ai Cập và từ mọi xứ khác.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 이집트와 모든 나라에서 솔로몬을 위하여 말들을 들여왔다.
ko.B: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 여러 나라에서 들여왔다.
ko.R: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 그 밖의 여러 나라에서 들여왔다.

pt.L: E traziam cavalos do Egito para Salomão, e de todas as terras.
pt.B: Cavalos eram trazidos para Salomão do Egito e de todas as terras.
pt.R: Os cavalos de Salomão vinham do Egito e de todas as outras terras.

decisions.choice: a shorter account than 1 Kings 10:28-29
decisions.reason: Kings names Egypt and Kue, gives the price of a chariot and a horse, and says that Solomon's traders sold them on to the kings of the Hittites and of Aram. Chronicles gave those details at 1:16-17; here it says only that horses came to Solomon from Egypt and from every land.

decisions.choice: horses from Egypt: what the law warned a king against
decisions.reason: The law of the king told him not to gather many horses or send the people back to Egypt to get them (Deuteronomy 17:16). The writer lists Solomon's horses without comment.

decisions.choice: were brought (Balanced); were brought in (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses "they were bringing out" with no named subject, a way of speaking of the trade in general; Balanced and Readable say it in the passive. Readable adds "other" since Egypt is one of the lands.

source.text: וּשְׁאָר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאֲחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְעַל־נְבוּאַ֞ת אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַשִּֽׁילוֹנִ֗י וּבַחֲזוֹת֙ יֶעְדּ֣וֹ הַחֹזֶ֔ה עַל־יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־נְבָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Solomon, the first and the last, [are] not they written on [the] words of Nathan the prophet, and on [the] prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in [the] visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Solomon, the first and the last, are they not written in the words of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Solomon, from first to last, are written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer about Jeroboam son of Nebat.
en.R: Everything else Solomon did, from beginning to end, is written in the records of the prophet Nathan, in the prophecy of Ahijah from Shiloh, and in the visions about Jeroboam son of Nebat that Iddo the seer received. (A seer was a prophet to whom God gave visions.)

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Salomón, los primeros y los postreros, ¿no están escritos en las palabras del profeta Natán, y en la profecía de Ahías el silonita, y en las visiones de Ido el vidente acerca de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Salomón, desde el primero hasta el último, están escritos en los registros del profeta Natán, en la profecía de Ahías el silonita y en las visiones de Ido el vidente acerca de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Salomón, desde el principio hasta el fin, está escrito en los registros del profeta Natán, en la profecía de Ahías de Silo y en las visiones acerca de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat que recibió Ido el vidente. (Un vidente era un profeta a quien Dios daba visiones).

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Salomon, les premiers et les derniers, ne sont-ils pas écrits dans les paroles de Nathan le prophète, et dans la prophétie d’Ahiya le Silonite, et dans les visions d’Iddo le voyant au sujet de Jéroboam fils de Nebath ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Salomon, du premier au dernier, est écrit dans les récits de Nathan le prophète, dans la prophétie d’Ahiya le Silonite et dans les visions d’Iddo le voyant au sujet de Jéroboam fils de Nebath.
fr.R: Tout ce que Salomon a fait d’autre, du début à la fin, a été écrit dans les récits du prophète Nathan, dans la prophétie d’Ahiya de Silo, et dans les visions au sujet de Jéroboam fils de Nebath que le voyant Iddo a reçues. (Un voyant était un prophète à qui Dieu donnait des visions.)

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Sulemani, ya kwanza na ya mwisho, je, hayajaandikwa katika maneno ya Nathani nabii, na katika unabii wa Ahiya Mshiloni, na katika maono ya Ido mwonaji juu ya Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Sulemani, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, yameandikwa katika kumbukumbu za nabii Nathani, katika unabii wa Ahiya Mshiloni, na katika maono ya Ido mwonaji kuhusu Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Sulemani, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, yameandikwa katika kumbukumbu za nabii Nathani, katika unabii wa Ahiya wa Shilo, na katika maono kuhusu Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliyopewa Ido mwonaji. (Mwonaji alikuwa nabii ambaye Mungu alimpa maono.)

vi.L: Các việc khác của Sa-lô-môn, từ đầu đến cuối, chẳng phải đã được chép trong lời của nhà tiên tri Na-than, trong lời tiên tri của A-hi-gia người Si-lô, và trong các khải tượng của nhà tiên kiến Y-đô về Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Sa-lô-môn, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong sách ghi chép của nhà tiên tri Na-than, trong lời tiên tri của A-hi-gia người Si-lô, và trong các khải tượng của nhà tiên kiến Y-đô về Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Sa-lô-môn đã làm, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong sách ghi chép của nhà tiên tri Na-than, trong lời tiên tri của A-hi-gia người Si-lô, và trong các khải tượng mà nhà tiên kiến Y-đô đã thấy về Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát. (Nhà tiên kiến là nhà tiên tri được Đức Chúa Trời cho thấy khải tượng.)

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬의 나머지 일들은 처음부터 끝까지 예언자 나단의 말들과 실로 사람 아히야의 예언과 선견자 잇도가 느밧의 아들 여로보암에 관하여 본 환상들에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?

pt.B: Os demais atos de Salomão, do primeiro ao último, estão escritos nos registros de Natã, o profeta, na profecia de Aías, o silonita, e nas visões de Ido, o vidente, acerca de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.

decisions.choice: different sources from 1 Kings 11:41
decisions.reason: Kings sends the reader to "the book of the matters of Solomon" for "all that he did, and his wisdom". Chronicles speaks of Solomon's matters "first and last" and names three prophetic writings instead: those of Nathan, Ahijah and Iddo.

decisions.choice: Nathan, Ahijah and Iddo: prophets whose writings recorded the reign
decisions.reason: Chronicles often names prophets as the writers of a king's history (1 Chronicles 29:29; 2 Chronicles 12:15; 13:22). Nathan spoke for God to David and helped make Solomon king (1 Chronicles 17; 1 Kings 1). Ahijah of Shiloh foretold that Jeroboam would rule ten tribes (1 Kings 11:29-39). Iddo's visions concerned Jeroboam. These writings have not survived.

decisions.choice: the seer: a prophet who received visions
decisions.reason: This word for "seer" comes from the verb "to see" and is used of a prophet to whom God showed things in visions, as of Gad, David's seer (1 Chronicles 21:9). Its sense is close to "prophet".

decisions.choice: are they not written?: a question that means "they are written"
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes. It is the usual way these books close a reign.

decisions.choice: the matters / the words of Nathan (Literal); the acts / the records of Nathan (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 11:41, Balanced says "the acts of Solomon" for his "matters". The same Hebrew word stands before Nathan's name, where it means his written account; Balanced and Readable say "records".

decisions.choice: are written
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the answer the question expects; Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: Ahijah from Shiloh; a prophet to whom God gave visions
decisions.reason: Readable says where Ahijah came from rather than using "Shilonite", and explains once what a seer was.

decisions.choice: the source formula: a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note sets for Spanish; Chronicles names prophets' writings as its sources, and the pattern of the formula is kept with "las palabras" (L) and "los registros" (B, R) of Nathan.

decisions.choice: "Ido el vidente"
decisions.reason: Iddo takes the usual Spanish form; "vidente" follows the Samuel terms note for the seer.

decisions.choice: "ne sont-ils pas écrits dans ... ?" (L); "est écrit dans" (B); "a été écrit dans" (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula of the terms note, as in French Kings: a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable. Chronicles names prophetic writings, so French says "les paroles" (L) and "les récits" (B, R) of Nathan, keeping the pattern of the Kings formula.

decisions.choice: maneno ya Nathani nabii (Literal); kumbukumbu za nabii Nathani (Balanced, Readable); unabii wa Ahiya; maono ya Ido mwonaji
decisions.reason: Chronicles names prophets' writings as its sources; the Swahili keeps the pattern of the Kings source formula (a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable) and calls them "kumbukumbu" (records) at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: sources: "chẳng phải đã được chép trong ... sao?" (L), "đều được chép trong ..." (B, R); "lời" (L), "sách ghi chép" (B, R) of Nathan
decisions.reason: The source formula of the terms note, with Chronicles' own sources in the same pattern (m4). The Hebrew "words" before Nathan's name means his records (m1), so Balanced and Readable say "sách ghi chép".

decisions.choice: "nhà tiên kiến" for the seer, explained once at R
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's word for *roʾeh* and *ḥozeh* (m3); Readable explains it here.

decisions.choice: "예언자 나단의 말들" (L), "예언자 나단의 기록" (B, R); "선견자 잇도"; a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Chronicles names its sources by prophets; the pattern follows the terms note's source formula, with "선견자" for *ḥozeh* as the Samuel terms.

decisions.choice: Os demais atos de Salomão, os primeiros e os últimos (L), do primeiro ao último (B); nas palavras (L), nos registros (B, R) de Natã, o profeta
alternatives: o livro dos atos de Salomão (1 Kings 11:41)
decisions.reason: The source note keeps the formula of 1 Kings 11:41 in Portuguese, "Os demais atos de X ... não estão escritos ...?", the question kept at Literal and stated at Balanced and Readable, as the English. Chronicles names three prophetic writings instead of Kings' book (m1), worded as the English: "nas palavras" (L) and "nos registros" (B, R) de Natã, "a profecia de Aías, o silonita", "as visões de Ido, o vidente".

decisions.choice: Natã; Aías, o silonita (L, B), Aías, de Siló (R); Ido, o vidente; Jeroboão, filho de Nebate
decisions.reason: Names as Samuel and Kings write them in Portuguese; "o vidente" as 1 Samuel 9:9 (m3). Readable says where Ahijah came from, as the English does, and explains once what a seer was.

decisions.reason: Kings says "the days that Solomon reigned ... were forty years"; Chronicles says "Solomon reigned ... forty years". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: forty years: the length of a generation

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The formula these books use for the death of a king, as at 1 Kings 11:43, which this verse repeats. There the Hebrew says "he was buried"; here it says "they buried him", with the same sense.

decisions.choice: the City of David: the old part of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The City of David was the stronghold David took from the Jebusites (1 Chronicles 11:5-7), where the kings of Judah were buried.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam his son: the next king
decisions.reason: Rehoboam's reign begins with the division of the kingdom (chapter 10).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout these books. Readable adds "with his ancestors" where the burial is named.

decisions.choice: was buried
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the wording of 1 Kings 11:43; "they buried him" has no particular subject, and the passive says the same thing.

decisions.choice: death and successor formulas of the Kings terms note
decisions.reason: "durmió con sus padres" (L), "descansó con sus antepasados" (B), "murió" (R), and the successor formula, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 11:43, which this verse repeats.

decisions.choice: alilala pamoja na baba zake (Literal); alipumzika pamoja na babu zake (Balanced); alikufa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The death and burial formula of the terms note, worded as in the Swahili 1 Kings 11:43.

decisions.choice: death and successor formulas of the terms note
decisions.reason: "nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình" (L), "an giấc cùng tổ tiên" (B), "qua đời" (R); successor "Y con trai vua trị vì thay vua" (L), "Y con trai vua lên kế vị" (B, R), as 1 Kings 11:43.

decisions.choice: "조상들과 함께 누웠고" (L), "잠들었고" (B), "죽었고" (R); the successor formula of the terms note
decisions.reason: The death and burial formula, one wording per level through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L), antepassados (B, R); Roboão
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 11:43 at each level, as the Kings and Chronicles terms set it; Literal says "o sepultaram" for Chronicles' "they buried him", and Balanced and Readable keep Kings' passive, as the English does (m1).
